sidebars.body_markdown: Fresh issue of 44,28,000 equity shares of face value ₹10 each.[^drhp-p29] Lead manager: Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited. Registrar: Bigshare Services Private Limited.[^drhp-p31] Proceeds: ₹1,130 lakhs for working capital; remainder for general corporate purposes (undisclosed).[^drhp-p48] No independent appraisal or monitoring agency appointed.[^drhp-p18]
sidebars.rationale: Summarises offer details in one scannable block; prose already covers but sidebar saves reader from hunting.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance

tables.after_paragraph: Revenue from operations fell from ₹90.21 crore in fiscal 2015 to ₹60.53 crore in fiscal 2018 — a decline of roughly one-third.[^drhp-p27]
tables.rationale: Shows revenue decline over five years; prose describes it but table makes the trend scannable.
tables.title: Revenue from operations (₹ crore)

tables.after_paragraph: Net profit after adjustments has been volatile. It stood at ₹0.96 crore in FY2014, dipped to ₹0.16 crore in FY2017 (the worst year of the five), and then jumped to ₹3.15 crore in FY2018.[^drhp-p27]
tables.rationale: Shows volatility and the jump in FY2018; complements revenue table.
tables.title: Net profit after adjustments (₹ crore)

tables.after_paragraph: Short-term borrowings increased from ₹30.82 crore in FY2014 to ₹35.37 crore in FY2018.[^drhp-p26] Long-term borrowings decreased from ₹5.87 crore to ₹1.33 crore over the same period.[^drhp-p26]
tables.rationale: Shows shift from long-term to short-term debt and asset growth; key risk data.
tables.title: Borrowings and total assets (₹ crore)
